value.rationale: For a naturally circular binary source, selecting a cut to realize its own ones-prefix-normal factor profile is an operationally meaningful canonicalization question. The exact four-root spectrum at the first nontrivial fixed weight and the asymptotic 2/3-to-1/3 split distinguish uniqueness of a successful cut from existence, giving a precise test family for circular jumbled-query canonicalization. Results are all-length and not merely a small census; no claim of broad generalizations.
